The '''Udnill system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Udnil II]]. A [[Battle of Udnil II|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place in the system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
